title: Add WELCOME discount code
description: Adds an optional discount code to applyDiscount. WELCOME gives five extra percent. Also renames logger to log across services. Tests updated and passing. Small extras in the same PR: the save button now reads Save changes, toCsv takes a separator, displayName prefers a nickname, byDate can sort newest first, retry gets an exponential backoff helper with a 250 ms base, and CONTRIBUTING says to run the tests.
